description: Fleetoo turns questions about your fleet into reports built from your own Fleetoo company data. Ask in English or Arabic for fuel spend and volume, trip distance and count, idling time, or vehicle utilization, broken down by vehicle, branch or driver where the data supports it, over the date range you choose, and get back a table and a chart. When a request could mean more than one thing, Fleetoo asks instead of guessing. You can re-display a result as a different chart or in the other language, and save reports to run again later. Fleetoo never changes your fleet data, and it only sees the company you sign in with.

defaultPrompt: How much did we spend on fuel in the last 12 months, by vehicle?
